method.label: existing Node fallback text-width geometry gate
method.description: Uses the existing character-weight width and estimated line-height path because Node has no document/canvas text-measurement context. All renderer geometry, strokes, panel padding, fixed line breaks and positions are unchanged.

limitations: Pass/fail is the current existing estimated geometry gate only, not native-font measured bounds or pixel/raster quality.
Color was tested for whole-caption coloring; partial-match correctness is outside this diagnostic. Color changes no layout geometry.
Panel plate artwork and glyph-visible-center calibration were not rendered or measured. All three backgrounds share the managed panel geometry.
No completed-media decoding, source audio processing, speech recognition, semantic selection or human quality decision occurred.
